dag_drafts.rationale: Concerted Diels-Alder addition of cyclopentadiene (C1=CCC=C1) to acrylonitrile (C=CC#N), a normal-electron-demand [4+2] cycloaddition. The two new C-C sigma bonds form simultaneously with conversion of the diene pi system into one double bond and the dienophile C=C into a single bond, so the reaction is a single concerted elementary step per stereochemical channel. Both stereochemical outcomes are investigated from ONE common pre-reaction complex (cyclopentadiene/acrylonitrile pi-stacked complex, declared as a single dot-joined node RC) so that the two barrier heights share a common reference: the endo channel (acrylonitrile carbonitrile group tucked under the diene pi system, maximizing secondary orbital overlap in the TS, giving endo-5-norbornene-2-carbonitrile) and the exo channel (nitrile pointing away from the diene, giving exo-5-norbornene-2-carbonitrile). No intermediates are expected on either path: the DA is a single concerted step with one first-order saddle per channel. Conditions modelled: gas phase, charge 0, multiplicity 1 (closed shell), B3LYP-D3(BJ)/def2-SVP with RIJCOSX/def2-J, i.e. within the project method policy (xtb, pm7, b3lyp/def2svp). Each channel is solved with the ts_prepare workflow (provided guess -> OptTS + analytic frequency -> bidirectional IRC -> frequency-verified endpoint minima), so the IRC direction proof connects TS_endo/TS_exo back to the shared RC and forward to the corresponding stereo-explicit product.
